LESSON: THE HOLY

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The 5.1 Prayer By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to read Matt
Topic 5.2: The Holy

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Holy. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in The Holy
2. Practise The Holy at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Holy

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in The Holy
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in The Holy. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise The Holy at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise The Holy at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Holy
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to The Holy. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Holy using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Holy in the examples.
2. Explain The Holy to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Holy.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Holy using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Holy important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Mention examples of promises they 1. What did Jesus Spirit learner should be able to: have been given by their parents promise His a) state the promise Jesus gave to
2. Read Acts 1: 4 and Acts 2:3-4 disciples? 45 5 lessons His disciples and desire to have
3. Be guided to write the work of the Holy Spirit on flash cards and read them aloud in pairs

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in The Holy
2. Practise The Holy at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Holy
